priorApprovedBaseline.policy: Human-accepted/committed NS03 baseline; no staging/commit/push in C.

decisions.summary: Root Frame is the schedule stack; row content navigates with only raw sessionId; detail imports no schedule and reads no navigation history. ActionBar back retains the mounted schedule. Search retention is source/store evidence, not a device search claim.

favoriteAdded/favoriteRemoved use public core addFavorite/removeFavorite on current selection within replaceState mutations; typed sessionById/isFavorite; NS03 exports, lifecycle and setFavoriteIds retained.

Strict ASCII decimal digits, then loaded-session lookup: 3 and 003 resolve to 3; 9999 parses but is unmatched; abc, 3abc, -1, empty and whitespace are rejected. Deliberately stricter than source parseInt.

GridLayout row content link and sibling Favorite/Remove button; add commits before title-only Favorite Added/OK alert; existing-favorite quirk and favorites-mode removal use exact confirmation strings. Cancel commits nothing; Remove removes. Android dialogs offer positive/negative only, no destructive styling.

Independent SessionDetail page with loading/error/retry, ready known/unknown, session fields, immediate no-dialog toggle, scalar selected/disabled accessibilityState and six disabled placeholders. Fixed light palette, ScrollView and ActionBar back.

One-shot root Frame loaded harness reads raw ns04SessionId launch extra only under __DEV__; directEntrySessionId rejects missing/empty/non-dev input. Navigates above Schedule without animation. Substitutes for a URL deep link; debug development-mode bundle only, release not built.

Real loader/core Vitest logic, no core mocks or snapshots: mutations/getters, frozen history, composition, favorites-some/favorites-order and helpers. All 34 NS03 tests retained; 5 files/69 tests twice. Native navigation/dialog/rendering are historical device evidence, not Vitest coverage.

Phase B installed A run 2 debug APK with matching installed SHA-256; B1–B6 and bounded PID logcat PASS. XML-derived taps, one swipe, no text input/hardware keys; coordinator inspected all 23 PNG files/20 distinct frames.

Phase A run 1 receipt helper wrote evidence before raw porcelain, failing exact clean-state gate; no product change. Coordinator authorized run 2 with unchanged scope and capture-before-write ordering. Run 2 passed all Phase A gates.

decisions.summary: No emulator was running before B. Coordinator normally launched RN01_API36 from its snapshot, with no settings changes; executor used that AVD.

Executor initially selected a partially visible row, then corrected the reference to first fully visible row What's New in Vue, id 6, from the same B1 XML before tapping. No extra swipe, relaunch or product change; original evidence retained.

Coordinator pixel inspection passed all 20 distinct frames (23 PNG files): no keyboard/personal content. Disabled controls differ only by missing border (XML enabled=false); dialog buttons are uppercase and lack destructive styling. These are NS07 concerns, not NS04 failures.

Android dialogs have positive/negative buttons only (D4); mode changes recreate the ListView and return to top (NS03 v-if), while detail back retains viewport (B3-back). __DEV__ harness is proven only in debug/development bundle; release not built.
